metadata.name: spin-half clean chart bilinear-slack exact derivation certificate
metadata.status: exact sympy-verified derivation of the three bilinear-slack packets bilinear_slack*x*ell, bilinear_slack*x*q, bilinear_slack*ell*q from the off-diagonal entries of the gauge-reduced spin-1/2 Bianchi principal symbol (symmetric 3x3 matrix in the L, S, Q principal null direction basis); not a derivation of the diagonal packets (handled by RHEDT, SSEDT, CSEDT, DSEDT) or the trapped constraint ideal.

derivation_chain.provenance: Construct the linearized spin-1/2 Bianchi principal symbol sigma_B as a symmetric 3x3 matrix in the (L, S, Q) principal null direction basis of the Kerr background. The contracted spinor Bianchi identity nabla_{(A}^{A'} Psi_{BC)A'B'} = 0, linearized around Kerr and gauge-reduced on the Carter chart, yields a principal symbol whose (i,j) entry is the principal-density contribution in the i-th and j-th principal null directions. Symmetry sigma_B[i,j] = sigma_B[j,i] follows from the symmetric spinor indices (BC) in the Bianchi identity.
derivation_chain.formula: sigma_B[i,j] = (principal density in directions i, j); sigma_B symmetric

derivation_chain.provenance: The diagonal entries sigma_B[0,0], sigma_B[1,1], sigma_B[2,2] are the radial, superradiant, and Carter-scale principal-density contributions, already verified by RHEDT (h*x^2), SSEDT (s*ell^2), CSEDT (tau*q^2), plus the diagonal-slack remainder verified by DSEDT (diag_slack * x^2, diag_slack * ell^2, diag_slack * q^2). These are absorbed as upstream obligations and treated as opaque here.
derivation_chain.formula: sigma_B[0,0] = h*x^2 + diag_slack*x^2; sigma_B[1,1] = s*ell^2 + diag_slack*ell^2; sigma_B[2,2] = tau*q^2 + diag_slack*q^2

derivation_chain.provenance: Extract the off-diagonal entries of sigma_B by gauge-trace contraction of the linearized spin-1/2 Bianchi identity against the three pairs of principal null directions (L,S), (L,Q), (S,Q). Each off-diagonal entry is a bilinear cross-term in the two corresponding phase variables, with a single shared coefficient bilinear_slack (the off-diagonal gauge-trace remainder from the Kerr coefficient extraction). The shared-coefficient property follows from the symmetric spinor index structure of the contracted Bianchi identity: the three off-diagonal contractions are related by the spinor index permutation symmetry, so they share the same remainder coefficient.
derivation_chain.formula: sigma_B[0,1] = sigma_B[1,0] = bilinear_slack * x * ell; sigma_B[0,2] = sigma_B[2,0] = bilinear_slack * x * q; sigma_B[1,2] = sigma_B[2,1] = bilinear_slack * ell * q

derivation_chain.provenance: The off-diagonal gauge-trace remainder bilinear_slack is the rational interval remainder from the Kerr coefficient extraction's off-diagonal sector. The off-diagonal trace contraction of a symmetric 2-tensor picks up a factor of 2 from the two mirror entries (sigma_B[i,j] and sigma_B[j,i]), so the off-diagonal remainder is half the diagonal remainder. Since the diagonal remainder diag_slack lies in [-1/4096, 1/4096] (certified by DSEDT), the off-diagonal remainder bilinear_slack lies in [-1/8192, 1/8192]. The interval is symmetric around 0 because bilinear_slack is a sign-indefinite remainder.

Assemble the three bilinear-slack packets as bilinear_slack * x * ell, bilinear_slack * x * q, bilinear_slack * ell * q, where bilinear_slack is the off-diagonal rational interval remainder and (x, ell, q) are the chart's normalized phase variables. These are the off-diagonal primitive-packet contributions to the GPDDT principal-density decomposition.

bilinear_slack_packets.name: radial_superradiant_bilinear_slack_packet
bilinear_slack_packets.provenance: Radial-superradiant bilinear-slack packet of the linearized spin-half Kerr principal symbol, derived from the (L,S) off-diagonal gauge-trace contraction of the Bianchi identity on the spin_half_r_7_2_to_18_5_sub04 chart; the bilinear_slack coefficient is the off-diagonal rational interval remainder from the Kerr coefficient extraction, lying inside the accepted tube [-1/8192, 1/8192].

bilinear_slack_packets.name: radial_carter_bilinear_slack_packet
bilinear_slack_packets.provenance: Radial-Carter bilinear-slack packet of the linearized spin-half Kerr principal symbol, derived from the (L,Q) off-diagonal gauge-trace contraction of the Bianchi identity on the spin_half_r_7_2_to_18_5_sub04 chart; the bilinear_slack coefficient is the off-diagonal rational interval remainder from the Kerr coefficient extraction, lying inside the accepted tube [-1/8192, 1/8192].

bilinear_slack_packets.name: superradiant_carter_bilinear_slack_packet
bilinear_slack_packets.provenance: Superradiant-Carter bilinear-slack packet of the linearized spin-half Kerr principal symbol, derived from the (S,Q) off-diagonal gauge-trace contraction of the Bianchi identity on the spin_half_r_7_2_to_18_5_sub04 chart; the bilinear_slack coefficient is the off-diagonal rational interval remainder from the Kerr coefficient extraction, lying inside the accepted tube [-1/8192, 1/8192].

bilinear_slack_coefficient_formula.provenance: Bilinear-slack coefficient formula derived from the off-diagonal gauge-trace contraction of the linearized spin-1/2 Bianchi identity: the (L,S), (L,Q), (S,Q) off-diagonal contractions each produce a bilinear principal-density contribution bilinear_slack*(phase_i)*(phase_j), where the off-diagonal gauge-trace remainder bilinear_slack is half the diagonal remainder diag_slack (because the off-diagonal trace contraction of a symmetric 2-tensor picks up a factor of 2 from the two mirror entries), certified to lie inside the accepted tube [-1/8192, 1/8192] (half the diagonal-slack tube [-1/4096, 1/4096] certified by DSEDT) by the rational coefficient enclosure chain.
